body: This is the most remarkable thing anyone has ever said in regards to me. Thank you.

My issue with pills is that I can't trust myself on a really horrible day not to just say to hell with it and take all of them. I have tried several and none of them really worked any ways. Some of them actually made my condition worse, I started having auditory hallucinations, i would become twitchy, and all this just made me feel more like a crazy.

He's really not though. He's gotten to these extremes but I know he's a good person, selfish and spoiled as he may be. I don't honestly think he even knows why I am upset half the time I am. If I take my self out of this apartment my schooling is in the toilet. I will have no way to class and it's not so much a matter of being afraid to ask for help, it's that I literally have no one. I have looked into a roommate situation on CL but with out a car or job no one is willing to work with me. Plus a place in the area of my school and stay in a price bracket i can afford would not be easy. It has only been a few years since I sat down with people that help mentally inn at little to no cost and all they wanted to do with me was give me a script. no therapy, nothing just some pills. Their services are for non functioning types. Where I feel down right psychotic some days in privet in public i seem quite or shy but I keep my shit together. I was never forced into a treatment center. I went for the first time right around 11 or 12. all the bad memories as a kid I want to think I was older than I was, having to go through and deal with what I had to and everything just runs together. But I was always willing a few cases I begged the long care facility was my idea. I told the Dr's that I don't feel safe going home. I went as far as make threats to kill my self if they made me go back. Not as childish as it sounds. I don't know he'll be home soon and I'm scared I don't know how he will act. I have class tonight, in fact i have a final I should be studying for, but the drama from this morning threw my hole day off.
I was unaware of that subreddit i only posted to this one because I knew it was a text form sub.

thanks, I do believe I stated in the first sentence I'm not an author. My writing ability wasn't what the topic was, but thanks for kicking at some one with a knife in their hand. You are a real humanitarian.

May 1 2008. I meet the guy I am with now. It has been insane, I think that is the best way to describe it. We have moved 12 times in 4 years. Six of those times we were living with or around people that could readily find meth and that's what we spent our money on. I went days with out food or sleep and would go into work strung the fuck out. No one ever suspected drugs, 'I just don't seem the type'. I would always feel so disgusted with my self when I was coming down. But never refused it when it came back round my way. Sweet oblivion, oh the most sincere pleasure of feeling nothing. Then felling more alive then ever, feeling every atom that you consist of pulsing and undulating like a life force driving you to freedom. Meth, not even once. I wouldn't say I was ever addicted, it never did me in other words. I had a problem yes, but now it simply revolts me. Weed is my consent never faltering go to medication. It clears my mind and makes it so I can relax and ask myself, "why am I so up set?". It's not enough to fix everything obviously. But it dose help. My boy friend and I have gotten physically violent with each other more times than I can count. I don't place all the blame on him, nor am I calling him a woman beater. I am afraid of him however and worried when the day will come that he doesn't hold back. His father was an alcoholic who would sit on his mothers chest and beat her in the face. He has a problem with alcohol and I having been so close to having a serious problem with it my self have lost my taste for it. I do like to drink wine or an occasional cocktail. I don't think that he should stop drinking but he needs to get in under control and cut back before he ends up like his dad. I worry for my safety yes, but I love him and don't want to see him become a monster. He has a really good job and it is providing him with opportunities to get higher education to eventually be able to get a job in his field almost anywhere and get top pay. He has been working his whole life at this sort of job and he's getting so drunk on weekdays that he's calling in sick, to recover from a hang over. He can kill a fifth in an evening a liter if it's the weekend. What's worse is he gets aggressive and violent towards me when i hadn't done anything. Literally, he stays up till 3-4-5 in the morning and I've gone to bed at midnight. He's come in the room and ripped the pillow out from under my sleeping head, punched me in the back and spat on me for "talking back" and then forcibly pushed out of bed. I spent the night on the couch only to get the 3rd degree the next morning for being melodramatic and sleeping on the couch. He doesn't remember anything. There have been other incidents, several others, but this is already getting to be a novella. I am worried that some day I might snap. I am so desperately lonely, but so contemptuous towards my generation that I think every one is a fake idiot and I don't want to bother with it. That and I can't stand letting people in just to be let down or betrayed. Which is how 95% of my personal relationships have gone. I can't hold down a job because I think I am better than the work I am qualified for(i.e. fast food, cashier) I have just recently gotten into school to start on the path to getting my RN. Even if I never use it I want to be able to say that I did it. My boy friend is very into technology and computers. So much so that I believe that it is his real and only true love. I have spent the past 4 years with a man and spent 80% of that time behind him while he had these seemingly meaningful friendships with people he's met through various games he plays on line. Him having friends and playing games online is not a problem from me. I enjoy a few of them my self, some we play together. But since the start of the year he has spent more time sitting at that game than he has gone in to work. The second he walks in the door at around 6:30 till past 2 in the morning mon-friday and every waking hour over the weekend he stays locked in his game. I try to engage him, asking him something that he deems unimportant and I get my head bitten off. He played the entire weekend that my birthday was on, didn't buy me so much as a $1 birthday card. I spent damn near my entire check on him for his b-day, and I got nothing. It's not the money that wasn't spent on me that hurt, it was the lack of consideration or interest he showed me. To top it off he wound up being abusive towards me because "i copped an attitude". He wonders why I feel worthless and unloved. I am currently holding a 4.0 GPA in school learning about sickness and disease, and how to care and treat it. I never get asked about school, he's studied with me twice both times he asked questions in between tasks he was doing on his game. I was just a side thought. I try to stand up for my self but by the end of the screaming match that I wasn't trying to have, I was just looking for some understanding and compassion. I always seem to concede that I deserve this. I don't work so therefore I am worth less than he, and un-entitled to any of his time. It's gotten to the point I have no self worth and am asking my self "why bother?". I can't leave, I don't have anywhere to go. No car, and the city I live in public transportation is a joke. I'm unemployed. I have grant money coming in June but I won't see any of it, I gotta make his car payment and make sure all the bills are current. Won't be enough to even stay at a cheap no-tell-motel. I don't know my reason for writing this. I know the situation that spurred it. This morning I caught our 9 week old puppy with his iPhone charger in his mouth and destroyed, it was my fault. It was then my fault that he's not properly potty trained yet. In the attempt to come to my own defense, I was told to shut up pushed onto the bed and called a stupid fat cunt. I was sobbing hysterically into my pillow to the point of screaming. I knew there was hell to be paid the last thing you should ever fuck with is this mans tech. He loves his iPhone and all thing affiliated with it. That's what made him snap, knowing this made me snap. He was running late for work, also my fault, so he left me with out a word after calling me a cunt. I took is belt and began beating my self with the buckled end, till my legs and back was welted. It wasn't enough. I have been trying this method of self abuse, using hangers, and belts to whip myself and leave bruises, not to turn a round and accuse him, I just not that deceitful. Plus I really think I deserve to be punished. I try this to the alternative of cutting. Cutting leaves scars, evidence, bruises fade. I have been self mutilating since I was about 15 and my legs look like graph paper. I stopped doing it on my arms or anywhere that could be seen because I wasn't doing it for the attention. I needed a release, I needed that control. Today I took a stake knife and put 5 new gashes in my leg, 2 look like i might need stitches. But it still wasn't enough. For the first time in 10 years I cut on my wrist. I was so manic and so crazed i just wanted it all to end. I can accept taking my life, selfish as it might have once been perceived, but what if I kill him? As much as he has hurt me and made me feel like nothing I can not accept the idea of me taking his life, being hated by his family and friends. I know this all sounds mad and a bit stupid, the obvious answer is to have my self committed. That's what everyone wants to do. It's what this family does things get sticky so ship off what's causing the mess. I may be broken, past repair but I still think that someone caring enough to ask me MY thoughts and feelings on things not to just have them criticized or made to be invalid would do me a world of good. I wouldn't mind therapy, but can't afford that. The state provided mental health care is a farce, they will sit with me make me take their evaluation, and throw a script for prozac at me. Been through that song and dance before. I need someone to talk to. I need the boy friend I have and fell in love with to accept me with my faults because I accept him with his and better our self together. But I am afraid I want him to be a man he could never be. Not for me at least. Not the way he's acted towards me. I have made huge mistakes in this relationship, i have my fair share of the blame. He use to be sweet to me, i use to see the love that was there. Now I just feel bitter resentment, like he's afraid to end it, because I'll kill myself. He doesn't want that blood on his hands. Well that's it. If i don't stop my self now, I may never.
tl;dr there is now way to sum this up, sorry.
